technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot's @Profile mechanism to back the stream repository with profile-specific backend strategies (e.g., in-memory for 'local').
Implement dependency resolution via Maven's nearest-wins / dependency mediation rules combined with a custom runtime resolution layer for runtime classpath conflicts between modules.
Use Spring Boot Actuator (Micrometer) to expose counter/metrics endpoints, registered as custom endpoints to feed the firehose|counter pipe dashboards.
Adopt a state-machine style lifecycle for the undeploy operation (states: DEPLOYED -> UNDEPLOYING -> UNDEPLOYED) so the same strategy can later be reused for streams and jobs.
DockerHub publishing will be implemented as a CI pipeline stage (e.g., GitHub Actions or Jenkins) that tags and pushes the s-c-d image on every commit to the main branch.
Screencast is delivered as a recorded video (scripted, recorded, edited, then published to a public platform such as YouTube).
XD module porting foundation is treated as a design-only deliverable (U7 explicitly says 'brainstorm and design'), producing an architecture document and reference scaffolding, not a full migration.
assumptions: A single experienced Spring/Java developer performs all the work; estimates include coding, unit tests, and basic debugging but not major architectural rework.
The s-c-d and s-c-s codebases are available locally and the developer is already familiar with them; ramp-up/onboarding is not included.
A standard local development environment (JDK 17+, Maven, IDE, Docker) is already configured and ready to use.
DockerHub credentials, a public repository, and a CI runner with Docker support are available out of the box for U3.
Screencast effort includes environment preparation, scripting, recording, light editing, and publishing; no professional voice-over or animation work is included.
U5 is limited to the 'singlenode' (single JVM) target; designing a consistent undeploy strategy for both jobs and streams is captured as design effort only within this story.
U7 is design-only (brainstorm + design document + light reference scaffolding); actual porting of XD modules is out of scope of this increment.
Integration testing focuses on the new features interacting together (profiles + metrics + undeploy); it does not cover full regression of the entire s-c-d codebase.
All effort is reported in productive work-hours (no meetings, vacations, or waiting time included).

activities.activity_name: Investigate msg bus/binding jar inclusion and fallback
activities.activity_description: Analyze how message bus and binding jars are currently included/excluded in s-c-d, try out inclusion/exclusion combinations, and document the binding selection and fallback mechanism when none is configured (covers U1).

Design and implement the capability to detect and resolve conflicts when two or more modules use different versions of the same jar (e.g. different spring-data versions), so the right bits are picked at runtime (covers U2). Includes conflict detection, resolution strategy, and unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Set up DockerHub publishing of s-c-d image
activities.activity_description: Configure a CI pipeline to build the s-c-d image, tag it appropriately, and push it to DockerHub so the latest commits are incrementally published to the remote location (covers U3). Includes credential handling and a smoke test of the push.

activities.activity_name: Create public screencast of firehose|counter pipe
activities.activity_description: Prepare a demo script, set up the recording environment, record the screencast demonstrating s-c-s and the development experience of the firehose|counter pipe, perform light editing, and publish it to a public video platform (covers U4).

activities.activity_name: Implement undeploy operation for singlenode target
activities.activity_description: Study the referenced PR design, agree on a consistent undeploy strategy usable later for both jobs and streams, and implement the undeploy operation for the single-JVM (singlenode) target so a running stream can be undeployed (covers U5). Includes unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Add profile support to core Admin application
activities.activity_description: Introduce Spring profiles to the core Admin app and wire the stream repository to a profile-driven backend strategy, including an in-memory implementation for the 'local' profile (covers U6). Includes configuration plumbing and tests for each profile.

activities.activity_name: Design foundation to port XD modules as s-c-s modules
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD module patterns, brainstorm how to map them to s-c-s concepts, and produce the foundation design (architecture document plus minimal reference scaffolding) that can serve as the base for migrating modules (covers U7).

Design and implement counter/metrics endpoints (e.g. via Spring Boot Actuator / Micrometer) so they can be consumed to feed the dashboards that demonstrate the firehose|counter pipe (covers U8). Includes wiring to the counter source and basic verification.

Run cross-feature integration tests combining the profile-backed repository, the new undeploy operation, the metrics endpoints, and the dependency resolution logic to ensure they work together and existing flows are not broken.

Update user-facing and developer documentation for the new features (profiles, undeploy, dependency resolution, metrics endpoints, DockerHub image, XD porting foundation) and perform final cleanup, code review fixes, and release notes drafting.
